CustomField.description: The date/time that a link in this specific Yesware sent email was most recently clicked. Only counts clicks if Yesware link tracking was enabled when the message was sent.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Yesware will automatically update this field every time a link click is registered for the Yesware sent email represented by this Task. This field captures the date/time of the most recent link click, only if Yesware link tracking was enabled.
CustomField.label: Yesware Last Link Click At
